title: A HEALING PILLAGER STILL GOES DOWN
why: Found by the overnight regression run: a pillager who was healing could be brought to no health and still stand. His heal gave back a sliver of health before the fall was counted, so he never went down, and the second fall that finishes him never came either. Now a pillager on no health goes down at once, healing or not, and the heal picks up again if he gets up.
now: A pillager who is healing now goes down when his health reaches nothing, instead of standing back up.
